parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
An operational amplifier (op-amp) has two input terminals and one output terminal.

State what is meant by the gain of an op-amp.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: State two effects of negative feedback on the gain of an amplifier circuit that uses an op-amp.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.lead:
Fig. 7.1 shows an op-amp circuit that uses negative feedback.

[[fig:f1]]
parts.text: State the name of the type of circuit shown in Fig. 7.1.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: On Fig. 7.1, label with the letter X a point in the circuit that is considered to be a virtual earth.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text: Calculate the gain of the circuit in Fig. 7.1.

parts.label: (c)(iv)
parts.text: Determine the value of *V*₍IN₎ when *V*₍OUT₎ is +6.5 V.

parts.label: (c)(v)
parts.text: Determine the value of *V*₍OUT₎ when *V*₍IN₎ is −5.4 V.
